title: Output: business processes as PlanDefinitions
description: Required fields follow model_process.plantuml and the Definition of Done in req:l3-processes-dod. Because this skill is judgment rather than deterministic, the output is a proposal plus its reasoning, not a completed write: every file arrives as a diff under the write-is-a-diff gate.

id.description: No dot. The publisher reads a dot as a path separator, and a dotted id is rejected at build time even though SUSHI accepts it.

name.description: A computable name for the process.

title.description: A short, user-friendly description of the process.

description.description: A detailed description of the process.

sourceBpmn.description: Path to the BPMN file this was derived from.

profiles.description: Asserted conformance. CRMIShareablePlanDefinition always; CRMIPublishablePlanDefinition once active.

action.description: One per BPMN activity node. Gateways and events are out of scope.

sourceNodeId.description: BPMN element id. This is what the round-trip check matches on.

relationship.description: before-start should be favoured, and a relationship should be characterised in one direction only.

not.description: The version element is set by the publication process, never by the author.

traceability.description: One link per BPMN node and per resolved lane. This is what the round-trip check consumes, and what lets a reviewer ask where an action came from.

diffs.description: Proposed file changes. Nothing lands until an explicit apply.

conflictsWithHandEdits.description: True triggers the regeneration-conflict gate: stop and ask, do not reconcile.

flags.description: Questions the BPMN does not settle. An unresolvable lane persona or a missing activity identifier belongs here, not in a guessed value.
